name: inqurix
description: InQurix - intelligent document discovery, evidence retrieval and business intelligence

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @inqurix/server && npm run build -w @inqurix/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @inqurix/desktop
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @inqurix/server
